note: Same ComfyUI graph for walking, attack, and death. Swap ANIMATION_NAME only. Weapons are a later W4 cosmetic layer — do not train a second doll model.

motion.walking:
- in-place walk loop
- alternating left/right foot steps
- clear arm swing opposite the legs
- subtle vertical bob
- feet stay visible and plant, then lift
motion.attack:
- in-place attack cycle, one strike or cast then return to idle
- arms and torso drive the hit
- feet stay planted, no locomotion
motion.death:
- in-place death collapse, then hold the last pose
- no get-up, no extra characters

female.BODY: The character is an adult woman. Keep a feminine silhouette. Clothing stays fully on.
female.HAIR: - long hair secondary motion: delayed sway one-eighth cycle after the head bob, tips jitter on each step, roots stay attached to the scalp
female.CHEST: - subtle chest bounce on each foot plant, delayed, small amplitude, follows the torso, no exaggeration

male.BODY: The character is an adult man. Keep a masculine silhouette.
male.HAIR: - hair and any cloak stay mostly with the skull; only light sway if the hair is long; no wild flutter
